sentences.en: The heart of a healthy forgiver is fully aware of how offensive we've been to God and how God has graciously forgiven us.

sentences.en: Talking with his son, the old man was forgiver of the young man's post doings.

sentences.en: You are truly a forgiver when you forgive murderers who never spill blood, thieves who never steal, and liars who utter no falsehood.
sentences.vi: Bạn thực sự là một người biết tha thứ khi bạn tha thứ cho những kẻ giết người không bao giờ đổ máu, những tên trộm không bao giờ ăn cắp và những kẻ nói dối không hề giả dối.

sentences.en: The old man was forgiver of the young man's past wrong doings.

sentences.en: And when you stand praying, if you hold anything against anyone, forgive him, so that your Farther in heaven may forgiver you your sins.
